recon.notes: Recon from one live read of each door on 2026-10-18, the day after the club's two October events. The club posts each event by hand some weeks ahead; its 2026 postings were Bears Night Out (Jan, Apr), Big Ole Bears Brunch (Mar), Beer Bust @ SF Eagle (Jun), Bears Night Out: Begoni Bistro (Jun), Bearrison Beer Bust (Jul), Bay Area Cub Contest at the Lone Star Saloon (Sep), BOSF Brunch at The Willows (Oct) and the Bearrison Street Fair with its deadlift competition (Oct 17). Between postings the collection is empty, so a run finding zero upcoming here is the club's normal state, not a failure. The Bear Calendar carried the fair and the deadlift competition as copies (its door is aggregator-only); the club's own collection is the statement.

traps.label: past[] / <div class="eventlist eventlist--past"> — the 30 newest of 142 already-happened items, from "Oct 17 Barbells, Bears, and Butts Deadlift Competition 2026" back to "Sep 8 Beer Bust" (2024), more behind pagination
traps.why: The configured page renders the past section when there is nothing upcoming, and the JSON door returns the same 30 as past[] (pageSize 30, nextPage true). Under the global allowPastEvents: true the scraper extracts them — expected behaviour for recent ones — but they must never be counted against publishedEventCount, which covers upcoming only, and a run that reports 30 extracted / 0 upcoming has read this source correctly.

openQuestions.q: Every collection row's location block is blank, so the Squarespace reader has no bar or address to fill from the feed; the venue sits only in the body text ("at The Lone Star Saloon (Bear Bar USA)"). Whether the body-text path recovers the bar for this club's rows can only be judged on a run with upcoming items — none existed on the recon date.

15 of the 30 rows in run 20261018-111539 carry city "unknown": the rows have no address block, the body names a venue without a city ("The Willows", "Bearrison Street Fair", "11th & Harrison St.") and the site's only city statement is the footer "San Francisco, CA 94103" and the LocalBusiness JSON-LD. A page-derived site-level city (footer / LocalBusiness) as the last rung for a registry promoter's own site is a generic proposal for the owner; nothing per site was added.

With nothing upcoming the crawl still follows every past item page from the listing (30 per read, ttl 3 days). Whether past item pages should be opened at all when the collection twin already carried the row is a generic crawl question.
